text_en: Then King Darius made a decree, and they searched the archives where the documents were stored in Babylon.
text_cn: 达理阿王遂下令，检查在巴比伦贮藏宝物的档案室。

text_en: But it was in Ecbatana, the capital in the province of Media, that a scroll was found on which this was written: “A record.
text_cn: 在厄克巴塔纳， 即在玛待省的王堡内，发现了一宗案卷，上边有这样的记载：“备忘录：

text_en: In the first year of his reign, King Cyrus issued a decree: Concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be rebuilt, the place where sacrifices are offered and burnt offerings are brought; its height shall be sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits,
text_cn: 居鲁士王元年，居鲁士王曾为耶路撒冷天主的殿宇，颁发上谕：殿宇应予重建，为在那里举行祭献，奉献火祭；殿应高六十肘，宽六十肘，

text_en: with three courses of hewn stones and one course of timber; let the cost be paid from the royal treasury.
text_cn: 三层用方石，一层用木料修建；所有费用概出自王室。

text_en: Moreover, let the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be restored and brought back to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its place; you shall put them in the house of God. ”
text_cn: 此外，凡拿步高取自耶路撒冷殿宇，而运到巴比伦的，天主殿宇的那些金银器皿，都应归还，送回耶路撒冷的殿宇内，各放在原处，安置在天主的殿宇内。”

text_en: “Now you, Tattenai, governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and you, their associates, the envoys in the province Beyond the River, keep away;
text_cn: “河西州长塔特乃、舍达波则乃，以及你们河西的同僚官员，应退出那地，

text_en: let the work on this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its site.
text_cn: 不可干涉天主殿宇的工程，任凭犹太人的总督和犹太人的长老，在原处重建天主的殿宇。

text_en: Moreover I make a decree regarding what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the rebuilding of this house of God: the cost is to be paid to these people, in full and without delay, from the royal revenue, the tribute of the province Beyond the River.
text_cn: 此外，我且颁下此旨，谕令你们为协助犹太人的长老，修建天主的殿应行的事：由河西收入王库的赋税，给那些人拨出充分的经费，不得有误！

text_en: Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams, or sheep for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, or oil, as the priests in Jerusalem require—let that be given to them day by day without fail,
text_cn: 他们向上天大主，献全燔祭所需要的牛犊、公绵羊和羔羊，以及面、盐、酒和油，应按耶路撒冷的司祭所指定的，每天供应，不得有误！

text_en: so that they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king and his children.
text_cn: 好使他们向上天的大主，奉献馨香祭，为君王和王孙的长寿祈祷。

text_en: Furthermore I decree that if anyone alters this edict, a beam shall be pulled out of the house of the perpetrator, who then shall be impaled on it. The house shall be made a dunghill.
text_cn: 我今颁下此令：凡有敢删改此令者，应把他屋内的梁木拆出，竖起来，把他悬在上边；令他的房屋从此成为粪堆。

text_en: May the God who has established his name there overthrow any king or people that shall put forth a hand to alter this, or to destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, make a decree; let it be done with all diligence. ”
text_cn: 凡有敢伸手删改此令，对耶路撒冷的天主殿宇，敢于破坏的王侯和人民，愿那使己名住在那里的天主，将他毁灭！我达理阿颁布此令，应悉依照遵行！”

text_en: Then, according to the word sent by King Darius, Tattenai, the governor of the province Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai, and their associates did with all diligence what King Darius had ordered.
text_cn: 于是河西州长塔特乃、舍达波则乃和他们的同僚，全照达理阿王所颁布的，一一遵行。

text_en: So the elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of the prophet Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo. They finished their building by command of the God of Israel and by decree of Cyrus, Darius, and King Artaxerxes of Persia;
text_cn: 犹太人的长老遂继续修建，因着先知哈盖，和依多的儿子匝加利亚的鼓励，进行的很是顺利；如此他们遵照以色列天主的旨意，并按照波斯王居鲁士和达理阿的谕令，完成了建殿的工程。

text_en: and this house was finished on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
text_cn: 圣殿完工的日期，是在达理阿王在位第六年，“阿达尔”月初三日。

text_en: The people of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of the returned exiles, celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.
text_cn: 以色列子民、司祭、肋未人，和其余由充军归来的人，兴高彩烈，为天主的殿举行了奉献礼。

text_en: They offered at the dedication of this house of God one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
text_cn: 为天主圣殿的奉献礼，奉献了牛犊一百头，公绵羊二百只，羔羊四百只；又照以色列支派的数目，奉献了十二只公山羊，为赎全以色列的罪。

text_en: Then they set the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses for the service of God at Jerusalem, as it is written in the book of Moses.
text_cn: 他们又派定了司祭，按照他们的编制，肋未人，按照他们的班次，在耶路撒冷值班奉侍天主，全照梅瑟书上所记载的。

text_en: On the fourteenth day of the first month the returned exiles kept the passover.
text_cn: 由充军归来的子民，于正月十四日，举行了逾越节。

text_en: For both the priests and the Levites had purified themselves; all of them were clean. So they killed the passover lamb for all the returned exiles, for their fellow priests, and for themselves.
text_cn: 肋未人全都圣洁了自己；他们既已圣洁了，就为所有充军归来的人，并为他们的兄弟司祭和自己，宰杀了逾越节羔羊。

text_en: It was eaten by the people of Israel who had returned from exile, and also by all who had joined them and separated themselves from the pollutions of the nations of the land to worship the Lord , the God of Israel.
text_cn: 凡由充军归来的以色列子民，并所有戒绝当地民族不洁的人，为寻求上主以色列的天主，都吃了逾越节羔羊。

text_en: With joy they celebrated the festival of unleavened bread seven days; for the Lord had made them joyful, and had turned the heart of the king of Assyria to them, so that he aided them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.
text_cn: 七天之久，欢乐地举行了无酵节，因为上主使亚述王的心倾向他们，协助了他们修建以色列天主的圣殿，都非常欢乐。
